claim: Recompute the frozen temporal/is-was Q8 command and weight-reader factors, pull the leading two task-balanced causal modes into physical residual space, and rank upstream writers through H3 value weights and downstream readers mode by mode.
collision_search: mode-specific weight reader and writer validation
novelty: Existing weight atlases rank pooled rank-one/rank-two activation bases. This runner pulls back the two canonical cross-task response modes and carries the source covectors through H3's actual value map before ranking upstream weights.

predictions.factor_replay: Pulled rank-two response agrees with the frozen exact task-balanced rank-two response within 1% relative RMSE.
predictions.gauge: Orthogonal Q8 gauge rotation preserves physical source/reader mode projectors within 1e-5.
predictions.known_components: L8H1 is top-decile upstream in at least one mode; L15H5 and L15H1 are top-quartile downstream in at least one mode.
predictions.mode_split: The two modes do not have identical writer and reader rankings; at least one ranking Spearman is below .90.
predictions.complete_inventory: All 110 upstream modules and 60 downstream modules are scored per mode with finite values.

null: If replay/gauge fails the instrument is invalid. If rankings are indistinguishable or miss known components, canonical modes remain an effect-space description and weight ranking is not licensed for causal component selection.
